name.zh-CN: 调阅原肠镜与手术病理
name.en: Review original endoscopy and resection histology

zh-CN: 调阅原肠镜与手术病理
en: Review original endoscopy and resection histology

text.zh-CN: 全结肠多发息肉，最大约1.2×1.2 cm；管状及绒毛管状腺瘤，直肠中高分化腺癌侵外膜，淋巴结6/27阳性。
text.en: Multiple colonic polyps, largest about1.2×1.2 cm; tubular/tubulovillous adenomas and moderately/well differentiated rectal adenocarcinoma extending through the wall, with6/27 positive nodes.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 盆壁、腹膜后及左锁骨上淋巴结，右髋臼、L3及L5异常摄取，报告考虑转移；左肾上腺饱满，不排除转移。
text.en: Abnormal uptake in pelvic/retroperitoneal/left supraclavicular nodes, right acetabulum andL3/L5 was interpreted as metastatic; a bulky left adrenal gland was indeterminate.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 病理和临床诊断家族性腺瘤性息肉病；未提供APC或其他胚系检测结果，亲属肠镜阴性不等于基因检测阴性。
text.en: Clinical/pathological diagnosis of familial adenomatous polyposis; noAPC or other germline result is supplied, and negative relative colonoscopy is not negative genetic testing.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 原报告予骨保护及髋部/腰椎放疗，住院时疼痛缓解但后续仍持续；患者拒绝进一步全身化疗。数月后下肢与外阴水肿、排尿困难，建议住院仍拒绝；未载最终生存结局。原放疗单位4000/5000 Gy不可信，未转换为剂量。
text.en: Bone-directed treatment and hip/lumbar radiotherapy were followed by reported inpatient pain relief, but pain later persisted. Further systemic chemotherapy was declined. Months later leg/vulval oedema and urinary difficulty prompted advice for admission, also declined; final survival outcome is absent. Source entries4000/5000 Gy are implausible and have not been converted into a dose.

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.zh-CN: PET提示骨和淋巴结转移，应按肿瘤进展评估，病灶组织证实未载
text.en: PET suggests bone/nodal spread requiring progression assessment; tissue confirmation of these lesions is not supplied

feedback.zh-CN: 疼痛部位与髋臼病灶相符，但应标注证据层级。
feedback.en: Pain location matches the acetabular lesion while the evidence level remains explicit.

text.zh-CN: 年轻人髋痛一定是运动损伤
text.en: Hip pain in a young adult must be a sports injury

feedback.zh-CN: 既往癌症和影像证据不能忽略。
feedback.en: Prior cancer and imaging evidence cannot be ignored.

text.zh-CN: 左肾上腺饱满已证明所有病灶都是良性
text.en: A bulky adrenal gland proves all lesions benign

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告仅说肾上腺性质不确定。

prompt.zh-CN: 阴性家族肠镜对遗传咨询意味着什么？
prompt.en: What do negative family colonoscopies mean for genetic counselling?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 仍需遗传咨询和适当胚系评估，家族史阴性不能排除遗传性息肉病
text.en: Genetic counselling and appropriate germline assessment remain indicated; negative family history does not exclude hereditary polyposis

feedback.zh-CN: 新发变异、嵌合及年龄相关表型均可能，不能假定具体变异。
feedback.en: De novo variants, mosaicism and age-related expression are possible without assuming a specific variant.

text.zh-CN: 父母肠镜正常即可取消患者遗传评估
text.en: Normal parental colonoscopy cancels patient genetic assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 临床表型强，家族检查不能替代胚系评估。
feedback.en: The strong phenotype is not replaced by relatives’ examinations.

text.zh-CN: 未经检测即可指定她有某个APC位点
text.en: Assign a specificAPC variant without testing

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样安全使用原文放疗剂量和后续症状？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.zh-CN: 原文4000/5000 Gy明显可疑不照抄；新水肿和排尿困难需及时评估并沟通拒治原因
text.en: Do not copy implausible4000/5000 Gy entries; new oedema and urinary difficulty require prompt assessment and discussion of refusal

feedback.zh-CN: 单位不能擅自修成可执行处方，也不能忽略后续警讯。
feedback.en: Do not silently turn uncertain units into a prescription or overlook later warning symptoms.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 早发多发腺瘤和直肠癌支持遗传性息肉病评估，后续骨/淋巴结影像提示转移，治疗拒绝仍需持续支持和沟通。
conclusion.en: Early polyposis and rectal cancer warrant hereditary assessment; later bone/nodal imaging suggested metastases, and declined treatment does not end supportive care or communication.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 无家族阳性史不能排除遗传性息肉病。
keyReasoning.en: Negative family history does not exclude hereditary polyposis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 影像怀疑、原病理和胚系证据须分开。
keyReasoning.en: Separate imaging suspicion, original histology and germline evidence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 明显单位错误不可直接进入处方。

boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
